# Cygnix Labs

> SEO and AI-search (GEO/AEO) tools for AI agents: free SKILL.md agent skills, a free MCP server (cygnix-seo-mcp), pay-per-event Apify actors (username cygnix_labs, callable via https://mcp.apify.com), and full skills on Agensi. Updated 2026-10-20.

## Free

- [Free SEO/GEO/AEO agent skills](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/skills/): 6 MIT skills, install with `npx skills add cygnixlabs-cmd/cygnix-seo-skills`
- [Cygnix SEO MCP server](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/mcp/): `npx -y cygnix-seo-mcp`, local keyword clustering, intent, GSC cannibalization, title/meta, content brief
